==Part 7: Karamja Unlock & Easy Diary==
{{Checklist| * Unlock '''Karamja''' if you haven't already * Open league menu, teleport to [[Karamja]] * Run to [[Brimhaven Agility Arena]]. Complete 10 vouchers * Leave arena, buy [[Snapdragon]] from [[Pirate Jackie the Fruit]] * Run to [[Karamja Volcano]], go to [[TzHaar]] area ([[Mor Ul Rek]]) * Safespot any Tzhaar (water spells) * Go upstairs, run to [[Musa Point]] * Pick 10 [[Banana]]s * Ask [[Luthas]] for a job * Fill crate with bananas * League menu tele to Karamja or charter back to [[Brimhaven]] * Take [[Hajedy|Hajedy's cart]] to [[Shilo Village]] * Run north across bridge, go upstairs to the east * Pay barkeep to sleep in [[Paramaya Inn]] (may need to go upstairs to trigger task) * Take shortcut across river * Withdraw [[Fly fishing rod]], [[Feather]]s * Fish 75 [[Raw trout|trout]], 1+ [[Raw salmon|salmon]] * Withdraw food, axe, small net, coins, slayer staff * Take cart to [[Brimhaven]] * Kill [[Snake]] near Fruit tree patch * Run south to [[Brimhaven Dungeon]] * Enter brimhaven dungeon * Kill [[Black demon]] in Brimhaven dungeon (safespot) * Karamja tele on league menu * Run south to [[Tai Bwo Wannai]] * Buy [[Machete]] from General store * Speak to [[Murcaily]] to begin [[Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup]] (near [[Hardwood Grove]]) * Cut [[Dense Jungle]] until fully depleted * Run south, catch a [[Karambwanji]] * Teleport to Varlamore with the league menu * Run west to [[Death's office]], sacrifice [[Slayer's staff]] to death * Buy buckets at general store, fill up [[Supercompost]] at farming patch to the west * Finish diary and lamp farming or herblore }}
